lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.

lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
Uske baad aaye jo azaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine, and after that let whatever sorrow comes come.

lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.

lines: Baam-e-meena se maahtaab utre
couplets.en: Let the moon descend from the rim of the wine flask.

lines: Baam-e-meena se maahtaab utre
Dast-e-saaqi mein aaftaab aaye
couplets.en: Let the moon descend from the rim of the wine flask and the sun come into the cupbearer's hand.

lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.

lines: Aaj tum yaad be-hisaab aaye
couplets.en: Today you came to mind beyond all reckoning.

lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.

lines: Har rag-e-khoon mein phir charaaghaan ho
Saamne phir woh be-naqaab aaye
couplets.en: May every vein light up again as you appear before me unveiled.

lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.

lines: Jal uthe bazm-e-ghair ke dar-o-baam
couplets.en: The doors and roof of the rival's gathering caught fire.

lines: Jal uthe bazm-e-ghair ke dar-o-baam
Jab bhi hum khaanamaan-kharaab aaye
couplets.en: Whenever we came, our home in ruins, the doors and roof of the rival's gathering caught fire.

lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.

lines: Faiz, thi raah sar-ba-sar manzil
couplets.en: Faiz, the whole road was the destination.

lines: Faiz, thi raah sar-ba-sar manzil
Hum jahaan pahunche kaamyaab aaye
couplets.en: Faiz, the whole road was our destination, and wherever we reached, we had succeeded.

Uske baad aaye jo azaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine, and after that let whatever sorrow comes come.
